title: Social media platforms still facing thousands of user addiction lawsuits after failed appeals
summary: It’s too early to say how these addictive design lawsuits will pan out, but so far, Meta lost two lawsuits over similar issues, marking the first time that the platform was held liable over child safety concerns in jury trials.
